summary: Documented M2-S03 (three base Profile files for Acme Support Tier 1, Acme Support Tier 2 and Acme Billing) after step-tester's Rebuild #2 re-test marked it tested. Re-rendered PLAN.md; appended seven decisions (D-M2S03-01..07) plus three planner open items (O-M2S03-01..03) to decisions.md; wrote three new workbook rows to workbook/03-profiles-permission-sets-and-psgs.md (CWB-PERM-010..012, one per Profile) and two to workbook/99-other-configuration.md (CWB-OTHER-013, -014, for package.xml and deploy-order.md); minted and anchored three traceability rows (REQ-026..028, continuing from the highest existing id REQ-025); recorded no manual tests to compile because M2-S03 declares none; and set the step's status to documented via build_plan.py. This step also closes M1 finding F-01 (the record-type-to-layout binding both M1 milestone reports named as unasserted anywhere in the tree, now resolved 9 layoutAssignments + 12 record-type references, exit 0), recorded as D-M2S03-07 and superseding the pointer-correction O-M2S01-01 asked for.
confidence_rationale: Per Step 11's per-step table: every artefact (three Profile files) produced a workbook row, every row carries a real source_req_id (REQ-026..028, all sourced to answered clarification Q7), every requirement this step serves has a traceability row, and re-running this documentation pass would replace the same five workbook rows and three traceability rows with the same content. Not MEDIUM: no artefact needed judgment to place in a section (Profile maps cleanly to Section 3), and no req_id was inferred from an ambiguous field. Two things recorded rather than treated as reducing confidence: the M2 mock deploy, not a cited skill, settles two of the three grounding gaps the builder recorded (D-M2S03-01, D-M2S03-02), and this run reads both M1 milestone reports to record F-01's closure rather than inferring it from artefacts alone.

Recorded as D-M2S03-01/-02 with a skill-gap signal rather than treated as a closed question in the library.
dimensions_skipped.retry_hint: Add the accepted layoutAssignments/visible=false pairing and a statement on Profile element-order enforcement to admin/record-types-and-page-layouts' element inventory so a future build does not re-derive the same fact from a fresh mock deploy.

process_observations.observation: All three Profile rows resolved against a real checker exit; check_record_type_layouts.py --manifest-dir artefacts --strict resolving 9 layoutAssignments and 12 record-type references and exiting 0 with 0 findings is a positive statement this build could not make before this step existed -- it is what closes M1 finding F-01.

The F-15 rebuild is the skill-gap loop working as standards/build-orchestration.md section 8 describes: a real org rejection (Description: data value too large) became a skill rule (PSVP-DESC-01/-02 in admin/permission-sets-vs-profiles), which this step's rebuild then satisfied by rewriting only the description element, verified byte-identical elsewhere by SHA-256.

Two elements this step needed were settled by one successful org validation rather than by either cited skill documenting them as valid: whether a layoutAssignments entry is accepted for a record type the same profile marks visible=false on, and whether Profile element order is enforced by the Metadata API. One passing deploy is evidence for this build, not a documented platform guarantee.

Two Questions-to-Ask rows from the two cited skills -- 'Does a managed package require this profile to be assigned?' and 'Are Person Accounts enabled on this org?' -- are unanswered by any of the plan's 97 clarifications, the same unaddressed-question shape D-M1S02-03 already records for Q24's 'defaulted on' half.

M1 finding F-01, carried as open in both reports/MILESTONE-M1-REPORT.md and reports/MILESTONE-M1-REPORT-v2.md, is closed by this step's own artefacts and test result. Neither report is rewritable by this agent; a human's next re-verification of M1 needs to record F-01 CLOSED rather than merely re-pointed to M2-S03.

assumptions[A1].steps[] in plan.json still reads only ["M2-S05"]. This is the third step in the build (after M1-S01 and M2-S02) whose artefacts are shaped by A1's conservative reading without being named in it.

M2-S03 is documented; M2-S05 (built) is the only remaining M2 step to test and document before the M2 milestone can be re-verified, and this step alone closes a HIGH finding (F-01) carried open since the M1 gate.
